response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"HTML, opening Scripture quotation (Ephesians 4:14–15)","severity":"major","source_quote":"But speaking the truth in love","suggested_fix":"Replace “sino que, siguiendo la verdad en amor” with “sino que, diciendo la verdad en amor” to retain the source’s meaning of speaking the truth.","translation_quote":"sino que, siguiendo la verdad en amor"},{"location":"HTML, paragraph beginning “La manera en que nos hablamos…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"But if we are not unwilling to speak the truth if it means someone will be displeased with us, are we not then at fault?","suggested_fix":"Correct the negation to match the printed source, for example: “Pero si estamos dispuestos a decir la verdad, aunque eso signifique que alguien se disguste con nosotros, ¿no somos entonces culpables?”","translation_quote":"Pero si no estamos dispuestos a decir la verdad cuando eso significa que alguien se disgustará con nosotros, ¿no somos entonces culpables?"},{"location":"HTML, final paragraph, quoted Ephesians 4:15","severity":"major","source_quote":"speaking the truth in love, [so that we] may grow up into him in all things","suggested_fix":"Replace “decir la verdad en amor” only if necessary to keep the Scripture quotation’s meaning consistent with the source; use “hablar la verdad en amor” rather than “seguir la verdad en amor” wherever the quoted phrase appears.","translation_quote":"decir la verdad en amor, [para que] crezcamos en todo en aquel que es la cabeza"}],"passed":false,"score":88}
